opsd.label: Compared with the full-pool control
opsd.explanation: The final 32-example setting scores above the 100-step full-pool OPSD control.
opsd.context: The search scores a fixed pool of 9,600 candidates. Every round starts from the initial student in the reference configuration; earlier checkpoints inform subsequent selection.
opsd.protocol: All displayed trained settings report 100 optimizer steps. Selection and prior rounds add compute: the first two cycles report approximately 8–14 GPU-hours, excluding the final aggressive round. The selector and artifacts are withheld; step/epoch semantics require clarification. Scores average three evaluation seeds, not three independent training runs.

evolver.metric: Eight-set full-test mean · 3,000 training rows per trained arm
evolver.label: Compared with original Math-3K
evolver.explanation: A mixed result: the evolved dataset improves over base, but scores below the original Math-3K reference.
evolver.context: A coding agent updates the data-processing program over five iterations. Reviews select the incumbent, while downstream diagnostics inform later proposals.
evolver.protocol: One SFT seed per candidate dataset. A 10% diagnostic subset was drawn from the full test files; the final full-test score includes that subset and is not fully untouched evaluation. Pipeline evolution reports 3.53 hours; total node occupancy including evaluation is approximately 30 hours. Full upstream method source and original run artifacts are not publicly linked.

self.metric: Seven-set transfer mean · Final corpus: 6,000 rows
self.label: Compared with the base model
self.explanation: The final refined corpus improves the reported transfer mean, with a non-monotonic trajectory.
self.context: Validation failures guide changes to the pipeline and corpus. The final set contains 6,000 rows; a preceding merge reached 7,000.
self.protocol: MATH-500 and AIME26 are described as in-loop probes and excluded from the seven-set headline. Seed records are 42,42,44; run identities and actual rollback evidence require clarification. Compute and original artifacts are pending. This seven-set mean is not directly comparable to the Evolver eight-set mean.

opsd.title: OPSD-Data-Lite

opsd.feedback: Student–teacher teachability signals across a fixed candidate pool.

opsd.available: Method description, configuration and evaluation harness. Selector and run artifacts pending.

image.title: Policy-Evolving Edit Synthesis
image.description: Turn batch-level successes and failures into policies for writing better image-edit instructions.
image.feedback: Fixed-rubric acceptance, axis scores and failure records; policy promotion requires support from two batches.
image.budget: 1,000 accepted image-edit pairs per training arm.
image.available: Core loop source, rubric tests and environment definition. Serving adapters, scene snapshots and judge outputs pending.

video.title: VideoRSI

video.feedback: Grounding, schema validity, text-only solvability, frozen-target difficulty and deduplication.

video.available: Method description, configuration and Video-MME evaluation source. Full pipeline and experiment artifacts pending.
